item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when (brief.md:58-71) asks the driver to write the results JSON and reproduce on a second run (logs with EXIT=), the fragment to report the figures and name the rubric commit and the excluded items, and tests/discovery/test_evaluation.py to pass at base and head recorded as baseline_suite and after_suite; gate_base.log and gate_head.log each end '18 passed' EXIT=0 and run1/2/3.log each end EXIT=0 with identical numbers.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal (brief.md:1-13) is to compute labelled-only nDCG@10 before and after the comparator rerank on the 30-item sheet, and no LLM call; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-rerank-ndcg-run.py:74 scores each item twice with sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score over embedding_rank and rerank_rank, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commit 508e534032e, changed_paths the three files, baseline_suite and after_suite both completed true with failure_count 0 at revisions 616897270 and 508e534032e, negative_control: none with the reason the write scope holds no test file.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief declares three write paths (brief.md:73-77); git show --stat 508e53403 lists exactly ssog-rerank-ndcg-run.py, ssog-rerank-ndcg-results.json and ssog-rerank-ndcg.html, so the diff sits inside the fence.

justifications.durability: the write scope includes no test file and the diff adds no assertion, so no test reddens if the driver's scoring regresses; only the three identical run logs evidence reproducibility, which is a determinism check rather than a regression guard.
justifications.evidence: gate_base.log and gate_head.log each end '18 passed' EXIT=0 at the revisions they name and the driver's own run1/2/3.log each end EXIT=0 with identical numbers, which my independent recomputation from the committed ssog-rerank-label-sheet.json reproduces in full.
justifications.fit: the driver follows the sibling evidence-script idiom of ssog-rerank-label-sheet-run.py (module docstring, argparse main, SEED and BOUNDARY_FAMILY constants); the three filenames carry the plan-slug token 'ssog' the brief mandated.
justifications.goal_fidelity: ssog-rerank-ndcg-run.py:74 calls ndcg_score over both ranks and the committed ssog-rerank-ndcg-results.json carries mean_ndcg_embedding 0.748642 and mean_ndcg_rerank 0.924940 over the 30 items, exactly the first figure §4's done-when asks for.
justifications.reuse: the metric delegates to sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score, matching imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.py:8's delegation idiom, and bootstrap_ci (run.py:105) computes a mean-of-per-item-differences interval that evaluation.py bootstrap_interval cannot, because that owner hard-codes roc_auc and refuses a single-class sample, so no owner is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 508e53403 lists only the three declared write paths, so no path outside the fence is touched.
